data.body:
[P2] Recover accepted executions during per-case teardown

The pytest fixture calls `close_case()` directly, bypassing the discovery in `settle_run()`. If Invoke is accepted but its response is lost, the item retains its marker without an ARN, so this loop skips it even when the service lists the execution as running. `quiesce()` only observes that execution; it never stops it, potentially exhausting the drain budget and preventing subsequent cases. Resolve invoked markers through `load_markers()` before stopping executions, and add a lost-response regression that exercises `close_case()` directly.
